law: Code on Wages, 2019, Section 17(2) — pay within 2 working days of removal / resignation

short: Keeping the workplace safe and giving the needed safety gear (helmet, gloves, shoes, belt, goggles etc.) free of cost is the employer's duty.

title: Women paid less than men
short: For the same work, women and men (any gender) must get equal pay.
law: Code on Wages, 2019, Section 3 — no gender discrimination in wages and recruitment

title: No leave in pregnancy / removed for pregnancy
short: If you worked at least 80 days in the last 12 months, you have a right to up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave — up to 8 weeks can be before delivery.
law: Code on Social Security, 2020 — maternity benefit (26 weeks, 80 days of work)

title: Gratuity not paid
short: After 5 years of continuous work with the same employer, on leaving / removal you get gratuity — 15 days' wages for every completed year.
law: Code on Social Security, 2020, Section 53 — gratuity (5 years; 1 year for fixed-term)

title: Bonus not paid
short: In a factory / establishment covered by the bonus law (usually 20 or more workers), a worker who worked at least 30 days in the year should get a bonus of at least 8.33% every year (for workers up to the fixed salary limit).
law: Code on Wages, 2019 — chapter on bonus (earlier the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965)

title: Sexual harassment / wrong touching, talk, gestures
short: At the workplace, wrong touching, dirty talk or gestures, or wrong demands are sexual harassment and an offence by law.
law: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
